title: Entschuldigung Herr Einstein: A Logical and Structural Critique of General Relativity's Foundational Axioms, Simultaneity, and the Coherence of Reference Frames
description: This paper presents a fundamental critique of certain operational definitions within General Relativity (GR), arguing that while the foundational insight of relativistic effects structuring physical reality is retained, specific derivations—particularly the operational definitions of time and simultaneity—embed logical circularities. The critique demonstrates that Einstein's operational definition of simultaneity in the 1905 paper is circular. The paper critiques the interpretation of the Terrell-Penrose effect, arguing that the perceived visual rotation is an artifact of reinterpreting an integrated, asynchronous rhythm of light arrival as instantaneous geometry, and is also biologically impossible to perceive at relativistic speeds due to the eye's physical constraints. The paper proposes a replacement for relativistic simultaneity based on Rhythmic Coherence replacing the concepts of absolute rest and spacetime curvature with mass-weighted temporal coherence and phase-locked delay.
